subject: Renewal: activation schedule + invoice cadence for 8→16 GPU amendment
messages:
From: Simon Chan <simon@lumenai.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Ramesh <priya@lumenai.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Jul 2028 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal window + interest in doubling reserved pool

Marissa —

We’re approaching our renewal on Aug 1 and the engineering team is asking whether we can double our reserved pool from 8 → 16 GPUs. Main asks from our side: predictable throughput for our inference fleet (we need a 99th pct latency guard at current request patterns), and a month-to-month commit we can budget against.

Can Redwood provide:
- a short summary of the amendment flow and timing (how long to activate extra capacity)
- a breakdown of incremental monthly commit (what we’d be billed each month) and any ramp schedule options
- any operational constraints during cutover (prefix caching, KV warmup window, expected throughput delta)

We’re open to a phased activation if that helps ops, but want a firm monthly commit for billing.

Thanks — happy to hop on a call this week.

—Simon
CTO, LumenAI

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Simon Chan <simon@lumenai.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Jul 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal window + interest in doubling reserved pool

Simon — thanks for the clear asks. High level response below; I’ll pull in ops/finance for the exact amendment and billing language.

Activation & timing
- We can do a staged activation (8 active → add 8 standby → promote) over 3 business days so you have continuity. Typical warmup for KV/prefix caching ~ 24–48 hours to reach steady-state latency.

Throughput & SLOs
- For the proposed committed pool of 16 GPUs we’ll guarantee throughput targets in the amendment: baseline SLA for tail latency and a throughput floor for burst windows. We’ll include per-route throttlestate and fallback to a compatible model variant if capacity is constrained.

Monthly commit (billing)
- We’ll convert your commitment from 8 GPU-months → 16 GPU-months effective on the activation date. We can keep monthly invoices on a fixed commit, or set a 60-day phased billing if you prefer smoothing.

Next steps
1) I’ll circulate a draft amendment (scope + effective date + invoicing) for your review.
2) Ben (pricing) will run the exact numbers and available promotional credit.
3) Ops will provide an activation runbook and a 48h readiness window.

If that sounds good I’ll send the draft this week.

—Marissa Cole
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Jul 2028 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: LumenAI renewal — target amendment and billing request

Hey team —

Simon at LumenAI wants to move from 8 → 16 GPUs at renewal. They explicitly want a firm monthly commit for budgeting. Ask: can we provide a straightforward amendment that:
- sets committed capacity to 16 GPU-months starting on activation date
- offers a 10% credit on incremental commit for the first 3 months as a ramp incentive
- preserves current SLA but adds a throughput guarantee for top-priority routes

Operational constraints: ops told me warmup ~48h and we should propose a staged activation (add 8 as standby, enable traffic slice, promote). They want monthly invoicing.

Ben — can you produce an updated pricing workbook and confirm whether the 10% promo is approvable for this deal size?
Neha — ops runbook (activation steps, rollback plan, monitoring hooks) please — I want a one-pager to attach to the amendment.

Thanks — I’d like to send a draft amendment to Simon by midday Fri.

—Marissa

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 Jul 2028 08:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: LumenAI renewal — target amendment and billing request

Marissa —

Attached is pricing_workback and a redline for the amendment. Quick summary:
- Incremental monthly commit: +8 GPU-months at $34,500 per GPU-month (list), net after 10% ramp-credit => $31,050 per GPU-month for first 3 months on the incremental portion only.
- Effective monthly outlay (month 1–3): existing 8*base + incremental 8*discounted = calc in sheet.
- After month 4: full commit at list rate unless we extend the ramp.

Approvals: I greenlight the 10% promotional credit for this renewal (sales discretionary up to this band). Finance confirmed no changes to payment terms (monthly invoicing) — they’ll accept standard Net30.

I also attached a one-page billing summary you can share externally.

—Ben
Head of Sales Ops

Attachments: Pricing_Workback_8to16_monthly_commit.xlsx; LumenAI_ReservedPool_Amendment_draft_v2.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Simon Chan <simon@lumenai.ai>
Cc: Priya Ramesh <priya@lumenai.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Jul 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: LumenAI renewal — amendment draft and activation plan

Simon — attaching the amendment draft and a short ops runbook. Key points:
- Committed capacity increased to 16 GPU-months, effective on the activation date you select.
- We propose activation window: 3 business days with a 48h warmup to full steady-state.
- Billing: monthly invoices for the full committed amount. To smooth ramp we applied a 10% credit to the incremental 8 GPU-months for months 1–3.

Attachments: LumenAI_ReservedPool_Amendment_draft_v2.pdf (redline), Pricing_Workback_8to16_monthly_commit.xlsx

If you’re comfortable I’ll route the amendment for final legal and DocuSign. Please confirm the activation date you’d like and whether you want staged cutover.

Best,
—Marissa

- We’ll take the staged activation (we prefer the reduced risk).

- Confirmed: monthly invoices, Net30. The 10% ramp credit looks good — appreciate that.
